description: One numeric metric column of a trace waterfall (TmTraceWaterfall.MetricColumns): the key looked up in TraceSpan.Metrics, the header a reader sees and the .NET numeric format string the value is rendered with. A column whose key no span reports renders an empty cell rather than a zero, so "not reported" and "reported as zero" stay distinguishable.

members.name: Key
members.description: The metric key, matched ORDINALLY against TraceSpan.Metrics. A column whose key no span carries renders an empty cell rather than a zero.

members.name: Label
members.description: The column header. A blank label falls back to Key.

members.name: Format
members.description: The .NET numeric format string ("N0", "0.00", "P0", …) applied with the component's culture. Null or blank means N0.
